description.value: God withdrew, but you can still read the shape of the silence He left. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks about the withdrawal, angels, or Uriel's binding specifically, as distinct from general theological knowledge.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 Recall Knowledge bonus is scoped to 'the withdrawal, angels, or Uriel's binding specifically' -- the same topic-has-no-roll-option problem as Faction Ledger.
